units.source_text: 1. [\[1\]](../Text/chapter01.xhtml#fnref1) 本文括弧内是作者后来增补的说明。​

en.t: The explanations in parentheses in the main text were added later by the author.

units.source_text: 2. [\[2\]](../Text/chapter01.xhtml#fnref2) 传说妙见菩萨能给人增寿。​

en.t: According to legend, Myoken Bodhisattva can extend a person's life.

units.source_text: 3. [\[3\]](../Text/chapter01.xhtml#fnref3) 在日本，每年阴历三月十三日（现阳历四月十三日），十三岁的少男少女穿上节日盛装，去寺庙参拜虚空藏菩萨，祈求福德和智慧。​

en.t: In Japan, every year on the thirteenth day of the third lunar month, now April 13 by the solar calendar, thirteen-year-old boys and girls dress in festive clothes and visit temples to worship Kokuzo Bodhisattva, praying for good fortune, virtue, and wisdom.

units.source_text: 4. [\[4\]](../Text/chapter01.xhtml#fnref4) 大隈重信（1838-1922），日本政治家，曾任外相、总理大臣，逝世时被授予侯爵位。​

en.t: Okuma Shigenobu (1838-1922) was a Japanese statesman who served as foreign minister and prime minister, and was posthumously awarded the rank of marquis.
